m2_n_boss_near.speaker: nadja
takes: You took the freight lift. Of course you did. Come down, then. Someone is waiting for you.

m2_n_boss_intro.speaker: nadja
takes: Welcome to Umbra. Nine floors under Helix, and they never once came down here. Meet Subject Zero. My life's work. Wake up, my darling. We have guests.

m2_n_boss_phase2.speaker: nadja
takes: Do you feel that? He is learning. Every bullet you fire teaches him something.

m2_n_boss_phase3.speaker: nadja
takes: No. No, no, no. Get up! I did not make you to lose to them!

m2_n_boss_dead.speaker: nadja
takes: What have you done? He was perfect. He was the only perfect thing I ever made.

m2_n_caught.speaker: nadja
takes: Careful with those hands. You have no idea what I could have given the world.

m2_boss_end.speaker: coleman
takes: Subject Zero is down and the doctor is in custody. The bird is on the roof. Bring her up, Fireteam. It is over.
